Google Release Radar

Search changes and team recommendations - September 2026
  • Search interpretation: September 2026 is a volatility-and-authority month. The May core update means organic movement should be judged over sustained windows, while Google's AI Search guidance raises the premium on pages that provide clear, expert answers.
  • Sabin implication: the strongest web opportunity is not simply more posting; it is making high-demand resources like Vaccines 101 Their History How They Work And Their Impact function as authoritative gateways into Sabin's vaccine expertise and current priorities.
  • Team recommendation: combine Search Console review with page-level GA4 engagement. Protect pages with sustained demand, then refresh pages where people arrive but do not stay long enough to absorb or act on the content.

Blog / Resource Digest

Content demand, risk, and recommended action - September 2026
  • Strategic finding: Sabin's strongest content demand is foundational vaccine education. The top three resource pages generated 1,442 sessions, led by Vaccines 101 Their History How They Work And Their Impact, which suggests audiences are using Sabin as an explainer source before they are looking for institutional news.
  • Strategic risk: some pages have enough demand to matter but are not holding attention. From Covid 19 To Typhoid 2026 Sabin Awards Spotlight Vaccine Pioneers had the lowest average engagement (2s), and the three priority pages combine 387 sessions with short engagement windows (2s, 5s, 8s), so the issue is likely page experience, intent match, or next-step clarity.
  • External context: Google's May core update and AI Search guidance make this more than an SEO housekeeping issue. Expert-led evergreen pages are where Sabin can show authority, but they need clear answers, internal pathways, fresh proof points, and useful media to keep visibility as search becomes more answer-oriented.
